files.justification: Template only; not portable. Trivia is stored as a string on each SyntaxToken (SyntaxToken.Trivia, SyntaxToken.cs L25); FullWidth = Trivia.Length+Text.Length (L52); SyntaxElement.ToString() defaults to IncludeTrivia.All (SyntaxElement.cs L1161-1164) which concatenates Trivia+Text of all tokens, reproducing input.
